risk_trigger: Reject payment terms < 30 days or punitive late fees (>1% per month).
recommended_clause: Payment shall be due within thirty (30) days following receipt of an undisputed invoice.

standard_requirement: Must be capped at 100% of total contract value.
risk_trigger: Reject uncapped or missing liability caps.
recommended_clause: In no event shall either party's aggregate liability arising out of or related to this Agreement exceed the total amount paid and payable by Customer hereunder.

standard_requirement: Must not exceed 0.5% per week or 5% maximum total contract cap.
risk_trigger: Reject clauses where liquidated damages exceed 0.5% per week or a 5% overall cap.
recommended_clause: Liquidated damages for delay shall be assessed at 0.5% of the delayed deliverable value per week, capped at 5% of the total contract value.

standard_requirement: Must exclude consequential, punitive, and indirect damages.
risk_trigger: Reject if indemnification covers consequential, punitive, or indirect damages.
recommended_clause: Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential or punitive damages, whether under tort, contract or otherwise.

risk_trigger: Reject if governing law or jurisdiction is missing, unilateral, or unusually biased.
recommended_clause: This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

standard_requirement: Vendor must explicitly protect against common web vulnerabilities, including: cross-site scripting (XSS), cross-site request forgery (CSRF), insecure file uploads, path traversal, server-side request forgery (SSRF), broken password resets, weak session management, vulnerable JWT secrets, overly inclusive CORS, missing rate limits, exposed test/staging environments, default credentials, unsigned webhooks, client-side only payment checks, IDOR/BOLA, trusting client input, sensitive logs, and exposed source maps.
risk_trigger: Reject if the contract does not hold the vendor liable for securing against these specific web vulnerabilities or lacks a comprehensive application security warranty.
recommended_clause: Vendor represents and warrants that the Software/Service is designed and tested to protect against standard web vulnerabilities, including but not limited to XSS, CSRF, SSRF, IDOR/BOLA, insecure file uploads, weak session management, and missing rate limits, and that no default credentials or exposed staging environments will be accessible in production.
